metadata.explanation: Task requires opening Chrome's history page. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches chrome://history pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction 'Open Chrome's history page' is fully covered by checking if active URL matches chrome://history.* pattern
Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the current URL from Chrome's address bar via accessibility tree
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match uses re.search which correctly matches the pattern as a substring, even with the https:// prefix prepended by the getter
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rules['expected'] to get the pattern list

Minor concern: getter prepends default goto_prefix='https://' producing 'https://chrome://history' which is semantically incorrect, but re.search still finds the chrome://history.* pattern as a substring so it works in practice
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider setting goto_prefix to empty string in the getter config to avoid constructing an invalid URL like 'https://chrome://history'. While re.search makes it work, explicit config would be cleaner and more robust.
